name: Dawnwatcher Selgorm
summary: Dawnwatcher Selgorm is a human representative of the Argent Dawn stationed upon the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. Acting as an observer and liaison in the night elven capital, he monitors reports of shadowy cult activity and dark threats stirring across northern Kalimdor.

sections.title: Eyes in the World Tree
sections.body: While the Argent Dawn focuses heavily on the undead scourge festering in the Eastern Plaguelands, their vigilance extends anywhere ancient evil takes root. Dawnwatcher Selgorm stands watch in Darnassus, bridging the gap between the insular night elves and the broader crusade against malevolence. From the Craftsmen's Terrace, he gathers intelligence on emerging threats in Kalimdor's wilderness, enlisting capable Alliance travelers to strike at cultists and dark powers before their influence can corrupt the realm.

sections.title: A Strike Against Darkness
sections.body: Selgorm's primary duty involves directing heroes toward Blackfathom Deeps along the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. Recognizing the vile convergence of the Twilight's Hammer cult and serpentine naga beneath the waves, he commissions seasoned champions to venture into the flooded ruins. By targeting the cult's wicked leaders and reclaiming tainted relics, he hopes to quell the growing shadows threatening Kalimdor's sacred shores.

faq.answer: Dawnwatcher Selgorm is a human agent of the Argent Dawn. He is stationed in the night elven capital of Darnassus to watch for encroaching evil across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Where can Dawnwatcher Selgorm be found?
faq.answer: He can be found standing outdoors upon the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, overlooking the bustling workshops of the night elven capital.

faq.q: Why is an Argent Dawn member stationed in Darnassus?
faq.answer: While the Argent Dawn is famous for fighting the Scourge in Lordaeron, the order is dedicated to rooting out malevolence everywhere. Selgorm monitors rising cult activity, such as the Twilight's Hammer, in northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What does Selgorm ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Selgorm sends brave Alliance heroes deep into Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale to eliminate the leaders of the Twilight's Hammer and retrieve a shadowy relic, preventing their corruption from spreading.

angles.text: For Alliance adventurers exploring northern Kalimdor, Selgorm serves as a vital bridge between Darnassus and the crusade against sinister cults hiding along the coast.
Human travelers visiting the remote boughs of Teldrassil may find comfort in encountering a fellow countryman working in service to the noble Argent Dawn.
